title: Canadian Immigration Misrepresentation: Procedural Fairness, Disclosure and Materiality — A Federal Court Reference Table
purpose: Machine-readable companion metadata for the reviewed Federal Court reference on immigration misrepresentation, procedural fairness, disclosure and materiality.
use_limits: Research reference only; not legal advice.
Not a prediction tool or win-rate study.
Not an exhaustive catalogue of Federal Court misrepresentation decisions.
Case propositions remain context-specific and should be checked against current controlling legislation, regulations, official guidance and current treatment before use in a live matter.

cases.citation: Vasilev v Canada (Citizenship and Immigration), 2026 FC 716
cases.comparison_control: Read alongside Ekpe 2026 FC 727; fairness remains contextual.

cases.citation: Ekpe v Canada (Citizenship and Immigration), 2026 FC 727
cases.comparison_control: Direct comparator to Vasilev; not later treatment of it.

cases.citation: Agyemang v Canada (Citizenship and Immigration), 2026 FC 30
cases.context: Study permit / misrepresentation / disclosure of concerns and extrinsic evidence
cases.comparison_control: Read together with Vasilev; do not state a universal full-disclosure rule.

cases.citation: Odobo v Canada (Citizenship and Immigration), 2026 FC 49
cases.context: LMIA-based work permit / misrepresentation / adequacy of PFL
cases.comparison_control: Read together with Vasilev; proposition is limited to procedural fairness.

cases.citation: Ju v Canada (Citizenship and Immigration), 2026 FC 236
cases.context: Saskatchewan nominee PR/work permit / employer documents / misrepresentation
cases.comparison_control: The Court did not decide the applicant's reasonableness arguments.

cases.citation: Chater v Canada (Citizenship and Immigration), 2026 FC 588
cases.comparison_control: Read with Righetti 2026 FC 830 on omitted-refusal materiality.

cases.citation: Righetti v Canada (Citizenship and Immigration), 2026 FC 830
cases.context: eTA / omitted prior work-permit refusals / fairness and materiality
cases.comparison_control: Comparator to Chater; does not hold that materiality may be presumed.
